Research Paper: MiniLMv2: Multi-Head Self-Attention Relation Distillation for Compressing Pretrained Transformers
Why Selected: Historical repository baseline; ultra-lightweight transformer cross-encoder reference.
Advantages: Fast CPU inference (~15ms/pair); tiny memory footprint (<250MB RAM); low latency.
Disadvantages: High lexical mismatch penalty; fails nli-003 (pizza/bicycle treated as 99.57% contradiction).
Metrics: Macro-F1, Accuracy, Contradiction Precision, Cross-Entropy Loss

Model Architecture: Disentangled Attention Encoder + ELECTRA-style RTD Head
Research Paper: DeBERTaV3: Improving DeBERTa using ELECTRA-Style Pre-Training with Gradient-Disentangled Embedding Sharing
Target Task: Primary NLI & Semantic Advice Benchmark (Task Group 1)
Why Selected: Pinned primary baseline in repository (semantic_advice.py); SOTA NLI accuracy for small encoders.
Advantages: Superior syntactic reasoning and boundary modeling via disentangled matrices.
Disadvantages: ~3x higher CPU latency than MiniLM; also fails nli-003 neutral test (99.33% contradiction).
Metrics: Macro-F1, Accuracy, Expected Calibration Error (ECE), Latency

Model Architecture: Modernized Bidirectional Encoder with RoPE, GeGLU, FlashAttention-2, Unpadding
Research Paper: Smarter, Better, Faster, Longer: A Modern Bidirectional Encoder for Fast, Memory-Efficient, and Long-Context Understanding
Target Task: Long-Context Document NLI & Policy Verification (Task Group 1)
Dataset: ContractNLI + MultiNLI (Full context up to 8,192 tokens)
Why Selected: Cutting-edge 2024 architecture with native 8k context window; eliminates 512-token truncation limit.
Advantages: Native 8,192 tokens without chunking; FlashAttention-2 speedups; superior long-document modeling.
Disadvantages: Requires PyTorch 2.2+; newly published weights require rigorous CPU baseline evaluation.
Laptop Feasibility: Feasible with truncated context (seq_len=512, CPU float32, bs=2, ~6 min/epoch)
NVIDIA Feasibility: Ideal (Full 8k context training with FlashAttention-2 and bf16)
Metrics: Macro-F1, Long-Context Retrieval Accuracy, Truncation Penalty, Latency

Model Architecture: Sparse N-gram Vectorizer (unigram/bigram) + L2 Logistic Regression with Platt Scaling
Dataset: Candidate V2 & Candidate V3 Provenance Suites
Why Selected: Classical, fully interpretable ML baseline to test if deep neural representations are truly necessary.
Advantages: Instantaneous training (<1s); microsecond inference; 100% deterministic; zero GPU/memory load.
Disadvantages: Incapable of abstract semantic reasoning; strictly dependent on lexical co-occurrence.
Laptop Feasibility: Fully Feasible (CPU, <2 seconds total run time)
NVIDIA Feasibility: CPU Bound / Trivial (runs instantaneously on any server)
Metrics: Macro-F1, False Negative Rate (Missed Dependencies), ROC-AUC, Sparsity

Model Architecture: DeBERTa-v3-small Encoder + 2-layer MLP Binary Classification Head
Research Paper: DeBERTaV3: Improving DeBERTa using ELECTRA-Style Pre-Training with Gradient-Disentangled Embedding Sharing
Dataset: Candidate V2 & Candidate V3 Root-Explicit Contrast Suites
Why Selected: Core fine-tuned subject model; requires comparison against V3 dataset to evaluate fix for NLI confound.
Advantages: Deep cross-attention over artifact content and ancestral declarations.
Disadvantages: Past checkpoint exhibited NLI confound (failed on 16 nli_context test pairs by confusing semantic truth with support rules).
Laptop Feasibility: Fully Feasible (CPU float32, bs=2, lr=2e-5, ~5 min/epoch)
NVIDIA Feasibility: Full Fine-Tuning across 10 epochs with multi-seed variance analysis (~3 min total)
Metrics: Macro-F1, Missed Dependency False Negative Rate (FNR), Precision, ECE

Research Paper: C-Pack: Packaged Resources To Advance General Chinese and English Embedding
Target Task: Dense Embedding Similarity vs Causal Dependency Baseline (Task Group 2)
Dataset: Candidate V2 & Candidate V3 Provenance Suites
Why Selected: Tests whether bi-encoder cosine similarity can substitute for cross-encoder dependency classification.
Advantages: Ultra-compact (33.5M params, <70MB); embeddings can be pre-computed and cached; rapid O(1) cosine similarity.
Disadvantages: Bi-encoders lack cross-attention; cannot resolve asymmetric directional dependency (A -> B != B -> A).
Metrics: ROC-AUC, Macro-F1 at optimal threshold, Directional Asymmetry Error Rate
